programme.title: Vegas: The Story of Sin City

programme.title: Vegas: The Story of Sin City
programme.desc: The Greatest Show on Earth - S1E4. The strip explodes with new Disney-fied hotels, casinos, and megastars, highlighting the evolution and continual reinvention of the strip in the face of difficulty. (03/24/2024)

programme.title: Death Cap: The Mushroom Murders
programme.desc: The Crime. Within days of attending a quiet family lunch in rural Victoria, Australia, three people are dead, one is fighting for their life in the ICU, and a fifth, Erin Patterson - the cook and host - becomes the leading suspect in a murder case.

programme.title: Death Cap: The Mushroom Murders
programme.desc: The Trial. After almost two years, the trial of Erin Patterson takes over the former coal town of Morwell, Victoria. With a mountain of evidence withheld from the jury, two stories unfurl - what the jury knows, and what is kept hidden from them.

programme.title: Death Cap: The Mushroom Murders
programme.desc: The Truth?. Erin Patterson takes the stand and brings doubt to every element of the prosecution's case. But as the cross-examination delves deeper, she introduces new claims, details and deceptions - and these small lies ultimately prove her undoing.

programme.title: Decades In Sports
programme.desc: 1990s - S1E4. In the 1990s, athletes' celebrity power transcends the world of sports; sports scandals are increasingly smeared across tabloid headlines, while Michael Jordan wins six titles and becomes one of the most recognized athletes in the world. (08/16/2026)

programme.title: Decades In Sports
programme.desc: 1980s - S1E3. As tensions between the USSR and the United States heat up in the 80s, so do sports rivalries; Evert vs. Navratilova and Bird vs. Magic in the NBA dominate their respective sports, while The Great One bursts onto the ice in the NHL. (08/09/2026)

programme.title: Decades In Sports
programme.desc: 1970s - S1E1. As cultural and political movements grow across the United States, their impact on sports is undeniable; women command a larger place on the American sports horizon, while free agency rebalances the dynamic between owners and players. (08/02/2026)

programme.title: Decades In Sports
programme.desc: 2000s - S1E5. National tragedy, historic comebacks and grand slams define the 2000s in sports; Tiger Woods in golf, the Williams sisters in tennis and a shakeup of one of the greatest baseball rivalries in history prove that sports belong to all Americans. (08/23/2026)

programme.title: Decades In Sports
programme.desc: 2010s. Huge names emerge in sports in the 2010s, including LeBron James, Simone Biles and Steph Curry; as social media revolutionizes fan engagement, direct interaction and sports betting change the way viewers see celebrity athletes forever.

programme.title: The Neighborhood
programme.desc: Welcome to the Splurge - S4E9. Calvin decides to splurge on an expensive jacket, then worries it's too special to risk wearing outside the house; Dave and Gemma worry their new friends' daughter is a bad influence on Grover. (12/06/2021)

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Driven to Tears; Rule of Dumb. Patrick gets his license and wins a car; a document reveals that Patrick is next in line to become a king.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Search and Rescue: Pups Save the Bike Race - S12E3. In Adventure Bay, a major bike race is underway, and nearly the entire town is participating; with so many bikes on the roads, maintaining safety is a challenge; Chase and his team of Safety and Rescue Pups are on the job. (08/16/2025)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Rescue Knights: Pups Save a Dozing Dragon - S8E33. When the Duke and Claw use a magic cauldron to put the people of Barkingburg to sleep, their plan backfires when the enchanted fog works on Sparks; it's up to the PAW Patrol to wake up the Dragon along with everyone else in town. (12/04/2021)

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Stop a Super Shaker; Pups Save a Flying Farmhouse. Farmer Al's harvest machine goes haywire and shakes up Adventure Bay, even threatening to rock the Lookout off its foundation; Farmer Al has a wild dream that the PAW Patrol must rescue him and Yumi when his animals start acting like humans.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Jungle Penguins; Pups Save a Freighter. When an ice floe carrying three penguins lands in the jungle, the pups must get the birds back to their frosty home; Daring Danny is locked out of the lighthouse Turbot left him to look after, with a freighter headed his way.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save a Goldfish; Pups Save a Flying Florist. Uncle Otis accidentally slips and tosses Julia and Julius's new goldfish, Marigold, into the river! When Ms. Marjorie and Mr. Park don wingsuits to see a rare flower, a flying squirrel sends them off course!

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Meet the Cat Pack - S9E3. When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help with stopping the creature. (05/28/2022)

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds A Fish Ladder / The Crew Builds A Construction Carnival. The crew constructs a ladder to help salmon bypass a dam blocking their upstream path; when a carnival cannot reach town, the pups build a Construction Carnival.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Builds an Underwater Shell Museum; The Crew Builds a Giant Shoe Store. Wheeler discovers a giant ancient shell deep in a cave, but when the pups try to dig it out, the cave almost collapses; the pups have to save Wheeler when ducks take him for a wild ride on Shopkeeper Shelley's giant shoe-shaped shoe store!

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Air Rescue: Pups vs. the Hum-Cloud; Air Rescue: Pups Stop the Mid-Air Magnet. Humdinger tries to sabotage the Air Rescue Pups' Air Show; Uncle Otis' powerful magnetic drone goes rogue and starts picking up every metal object in sight.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Pups Save the Wacky Water Skiers; Pups Save the Mayor's Assistant. When Emmy and Eddie take a joyride, Hurricane Harrigan and Cap'n Turbot get caught water-skiing behind the out-of-control boat.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: The Crew Demolishes a Super Maze; The Crew Demolishes Through a Secret Cavern. It's demolition time for Rubble and Crew when the Meister brothers' argument ends with big walls all over Builder Cove; Rubble and the pups use their demolition vehicles to save Truffles and find an old pirate's buried treasure!

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Flaming Flounder; Fire Rescue: Pups Make the News. Francois' pants catch on fire, sending both the Lighthouse and Cap'n Turbot's Flounder up in flames; a news crew is in town when Chickaletta accidentally causes a fire in Adventure Bay's new parkette.

programme.title: PAW Patrol
programme.desc: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Big BBQ - S11E32. Adventure Bay gets a fire station; when disaster strikes during the opening day BBQ, it's up to the PAW Patrol in their new fire rescue gear and vehicles to put it out. (01/25/2025)
